traits: One contiguous body, broad base tapering through three cloud tiers.
Two large raised spiral ears, each curling inward; upper pair of pearl forms sits at ear bases.
One central stacked curl crest with a hooked top.
One four-point forehead sparkle centered on the crest.
Two lower round pearl paws plus two upper pearl forms; four total visible pearl forms.
Two small pointed white upper teeth at opposite mouth corners.
Two large dark plum eyes with white and aqua highlights.
Plum/navy contours surround grey-lavender painted masses.
No neck, separate torso, crown, armor, fingers or realistic smoke.
topology_visual_note: Portrait visibly has four pearl forms: two at ear bases and two on the floor. Preserve these locations; do not reinterpret the upper pair as extra floor feet. Their anatomical naming is pending signature.
forbidden_changes: new boss or enlarged hall-bunny substitute
new face, realistic teeth, snarl, injury or monster anatomy
armor, crown or other new prop
rainbow palette mixed into Grand Puff
extra/missing ears, teeth, pearl forms or crest

scale.method: Manual visible-ink bounds in real unscaled 1280x720 Mobile captures, approximately +/-3 px; excludes airborne dust/wake. Ratios are screen-space observations at different scene depths, not physical world units.
scale.acceptance: Observed current framing only. No use of BOSS_H placeholder as size authority; owner must sign final relative scale.
